policy: A flag records an evidence gap, discrepancy, scope limitation, or verified policy restriction. Null means not confirmed, never a negative physical finding. Unverified and flagged rows remain published with official sources; they are not silently dropped or used to block integration.

flags.title: Item-specific “solid gold” wording is not stated
flags.detail: No item-specific title or specification explicitly describes any of these 16 settings/rings as “solid gold.” Karat wording alone is not substituted for that checklist requirement. A page-wide “solid gold” phrase associated with unrelated VRAI editorial jewelry is not treated as evidence for this setting. This is a documentation gap, not proof that any item is plated or filled.
flags.recommended_action: Ask each seller in writing to confirm “solid gold, not plated, vermeil, filled, overlay, or gold-tone,” and keep the reply with the order.

flags.title: Physical hallmark and maker’s mark are not documented
flags.detail: None of the 19 captured product pages documents the physical karat stamp inside the band plus a maker’s/manufacturer’s mark. Stock numbers, styles, and URL identifiers are not physical hallmarks. Both fields remain null, not false.
flags.recommended_action: Before relying on the marking, photograph the inside of the band and have an independent jeweller read the karat stamp and maker’s mark under magnification.

flags.title: Metal weight in grams is missing for 18 of 19 items
flags.detail: Only VRAI publishes an item-specific metal weight: 2.86 g at ring size 6. The other 18 weight fields remain blank. No gross-ring estimate, stone-inclusive estimate, or average weight is substituted; melt comparisons are therefore unavailable for those rows.
flags.recommended_action: Request the metal-only gram weight for the exact size and configuration, then verify it on a jeweller’s scale before calculating fine-gold content.

flags.title: Zales V-19957449: rejected snippet $719.20; current labeled price $899.00
flags.detail: An earlier search snippet showed Discounted Price $719.20 and Original Price $899.00. The directly fetched official page shows Discounted Price $899.00. Only the official-page value is assigned; the snippet remains rejected audit evidence, not a second current price.
flags.recommended_action: Recheck the official product page and cart before purchase; do not budget from the cached snippet.

flags.title: Blue Nile 193625: rejected snippet $1,845; current setting price $1,950
flags.detail: An earlier search snippet showed $1,845 for this URL. The directly fetched official page shows $1,950 labeled Setting Price. The current official-page value is recorded and the snippet is rejected.
flags.recommended_action: Recheck the live setting price and stone total before purchase.

flags.title: Blue Nile 315661: rejected promotional snippet; current setting price $2,210
flags.detail: An earlier snippet displayed a 25% promotion and $1,657. The directly fetched official page shows $2,210 Setting Price with no corresponding discount in the retrieved text. The promotional figure is not published.
flags.recommended_action: If a promotion is expected, verify the actual cart discount line rather than relying on a snippet.

flags.title: Brilliant Earth rendered EUR, not USD
flags.detail: The official Brilliant Earth product page rendered €990.00 Setting Only. No USD item price was displayed in the captured content, so the record remains EUR and no exchange-rate conversion or USD substitution is made.
flags.recommended_action: Select the intended US region and obtain a fresh USD quote before comparing with USD rows.

flags.title: VRAI price is absent from the retrieved product text
flags.detail: The official configurator supplied setting details and a size-6 metal weight but no price string in the retrieved product chunks. The price and currency fields are blank. A search snippet claiming “Starting at $1,035” is rejected and is not used.
flags.recommended_action: Obtain the price for this exact configuration in the configurator or request a written quote.

flags.title: James Allen item 41515 redirects to a sold-out Blue Nile page
flags.detail: The captured James Allen comfort-fit item 41515 URL redirected to Blue Nile and displayed “This popular style is sold out.” Blue Nile’s official James Allen page describes an exclusive curated collection. Item 41515 is excluded; BN-315661 remains a Blue Nile-sold James Allen design.
flags.recommended_action: Treat Blue Nile as the seller for the included James Allen design and do not revive the sold-out item from a cached price.

flags.title: Blue Nile excludes resized-after-purchase and custom orders
flags.detail: Blue Nile’s official policy states a 30-day window from shipment and excludes personalized jewelry, custom orders, engraved items, items resized after initial purchase, Diamond Upgrade Program purchases, clearance, and Final Sale items. Two complimentary returns per customer/year are stated; other shipping circumstances can incur fees.
flags.recommended_action: Keep the ring unworn and unresized until independent inspection is complete and you have decided to keep it.

flags.title: Zales online returns depend on where resizing was performed
flags.detail: The official return policy allows 30-day returns and excludes custom designs and jewelry altered/modified beyond sizing or stone setting. The separate official ring-sizer PDF says rings purchased and sized from the online store can be returned/exchanged, but rings resized at a Zales store, another retailer, or an independent jeweler are not accepted for online refund/exchange. This is not a blanket “all resized rings” rule; the location/channel matters.
flags.recommended_action: Before any resize, obtain written confirmation for the exact item and purchase channel. Do not use an independent jeweller for resizing before the return decision.

flags.title: LBMA tabulated prices require licensed portal access
flags.detail: LBMA states that historical tabulated Precious Metal Prices moved to the MyLBMA Portal and require an IBA licence. No unlicensed LBMA fix is copied. The calculator instead uses the directly fetched World Gold Council spot quote with its explicit quote date and ICE Data Services attribution.
flags.recommended_action: Use appropriately licensed benchmark data for contract-grade valuation; otherwise retain the dated WGC quote and its limitations.

flags.title: Costco candidate not added: price and gram weight did not render
flags.detail: The directly fetched Costco page for item 1596365 exposed 0.50 ctw, VS2/I, 12 natural untreated diamonds, and 14kt white or yellow gold options, but no current price or gram weight in the retrieved content. It is not integrated as a priced engagement-ring row, and no unrelated cached price is assigned.
flags.recommended_action: If this candidate is revisited, capture the exact item price while signed in and obtain a metal-only gram weight from Costco.

flags.title: Setting-only and complete-ring price bases are not directly comparable
flags.detail: Ten Blue Nile rows, the Brilliant Earth row, and the VRAI row use a setting/configurator basis (12 rows); the four Zales rows and three Stone and Strand rows are complete diamond-ring products. Two Zales prices are additionally unassigned under F-018. Prices are never ranked across these bases, and EUR is not converted into USD.
flags.recommended_action: Compare setting prices only with setting prices, and add the exact centre-stone cost before comparing with a complete ring.

flags.title: Numeric band-width and depth coverage is incomplete
flags.detail: Five rows have no numeric band width (four Zales rows plus VRAI, which says only “Standard”). Eighteen rows have no numeric band depth/thickness; only VRAI publishes 1.6 mm depth. All unavailable dimensions remain blank.
flags.recommended_action: Ask for the exact band width and depth/thickness in millimetres for the selected size; do not infer them from photographs.

flags.title: Zales gold colour is not explicit in the retrieved titles
flags.detail: The four Zales titles state “10K Gold” but do not explicitly state yellow, white, or rose in the retrieved text. Their metal is recorded as 10K Gold and colour is blank; no colour is inferred from images or URLs.
flags.recommended_action: Confirm the selected metal colour in writing and in the cart before purchase.

flags.title: Two Zales pages render unlabeled price amounts
flags.detail: Z-20303279 renders “$979.30  $1,399.00 30% Off” and Z-20301172 renders “$769.30  $1,099.00 30% Off” without Discounted/Original labels in the current extraction. Both amounts are preserved verbatim, but current price, original price, and currency fields are not assigned by position or discount arithmetic.
flags.recommended_action: Open the official page/cart and obtain explicitly labeled current and original prices before using these rows in a price comparison.

flags.title: Brilliant Earth excludes resized/modified and custom-designed returns
flags.detail: Brilliant Earth’s official policy offers free 30-day returns but excludes custom-designed jewelry and rings that have been resized or modified. It separately says an engraved ring can be returned with a $40 engraving-removal charge. Resizing is complimentary within the stated 60-day/1-year conditions, but a resize can affect return eligibility.
flags.recommended_action: Keep the ring unworn, unmodified, and unresized until inspection and the keep/return decision are complete; budget the engraving fee if applicable.

flags.title: VRAI refunds can include a $300 recycling fee and value-based store-credit terms
flags.detail: VRAI states that eligible items below $15,000 may receive store credit or a refund minus the recycling fee; items above $15,000 are store-credit only. The engagement-ring recycling fee is $300 and is waived for store credit. Modified/resized rings, third-party alterations, and custom-designed items are non-eligible.
flags.recommended_action: Confirm the exact refund-versus-store-credit outcome and recycling fee in writing before purchase; do not resize or alter before the return decision.

flags.title: Written permission for independent testing was not captured
flags.detail: The captured policies do not explicitly confirm that an independent jeweller may perform non-destructive inspection/XRF without affecting return eligibility. This is an evidence gap, not a seller refusal. The independent_test_permission field remains null for every row and retailer.
flags.recommended_action: Before purchase, ask in writing whether independent non-destructive XRF/inspection is permitted without voiding returns. If the seller refuses independent verification or a return, do not buy.

flags.title: VRAI candidate BBB profile is not identity-confirmed
flags.detail: The candidate BBB profile is named Vrai and lists alternate name Vrai & Oro; VRAI’s official privacy policy identifies Vrai & Oro, LLC as VRAI. However, the BBB profile does not link vrai.com. Its ratings, review average, and complaint counts are withheld rather than attributed to VRAI as confirmed seller-reputation facts.
flags.recommended_action: Obtain an independent profile that explicitly links the legal entity or official website before assigning reputation metrics.

flags.title: Zales BBB metrics are combined Signet metrics
flags.detail: The BBB profile explicitly links zales.com but states that it covers combined customer reviews and complaint activity for Signet Jewelers locations in the US and Canada and online sales. It includes Zales and other brands. The dated metrics are published only with this combined-parent scope, never as Zales-only figures.
flags.recommended_action: Use the combined figures only as parent-company context and seek Zales-specific review evidence before drawing brand-level conclusions.

flags.title: No physical inspection, XRF assay, or scale verification was performed
flags.detail: This repository is remote document research. No ring was handled, photographed, weighed, hallmarked in person, or XRF-tested. Retailer statements are recorded as claims from official pages, not independently verified physical properties. Every row remains subject to post-delivery independent verification.
flags.recommended_action: Before wearing or resizing, use an independent jeweller for non-destructive XRF, hallmark/maker’s-mark inspection, and metal-only weight verification, subject to the seller’s written return terms.

flags.title: All 3 Stone and Strand rings are final sale / non-returnable — they cannot be returned after independent testing
flags.detail: Each of the three Stone and Strand product pages retrieved on 2026-10-22 shows 'Final Sale — This product is non-returnable' (for Rita and Mia it is also in the Product Description bullets verbatim), on the same page that advertises '100 Day Returns'. The retailer's returns policy confirms the exclusion: 'Any piece marked as final sale on the product page or purchased at a discount of 50% or greater' cannot be returned or exchanged. Rita (60% off) and Mia (50% off) are non-returnable on the discount rule alone. Consequence for this project's method: the receive → independent XRF test → return if it fails sequence cannot be followed for these three rings at these prices. They are published here because they are the first captured listings to say 'solid gold' — not as recommendations.
flags.recommended_action: Do not buy these three rings as listed if post-delivery verification matters — there is no return path. If buying from Stone and Strand, choose an item that is not marked final sale and is discounted less than 50%, and get written confirmation before paying that it can be returned after independent testing.

flags.title: The Mia Ring page contradicts itself on karat: spec table says 14K, image alt text says 10K
flags.detail: On the live Mia Ring page retrieved 2026-10-22, the structured Metals spec states 'Gold Karat: 14K', while the product-image alt text on the same page repeatedly says '10K Yellow Gold The Mia Diamond Ring'. The published karat (14) is taken from the spec table, the structured source; the conflicting alt text is quoted in evidence/listings/ss-mia.md and the item carries this flag and its notes mark the karat as contested. One of the two numbers on the retailer's own page is wrong; this dataset cannot determine which.
flags.recommended_action: Ask Stone and Strand in writing which karat the Mia Ring actually is, and keep the reply. An XRF test after delivery would settle it — but note this ring is final sale (F-025), so there is no return if the test disagrees with the listing.

flags.title: Catbird not yet included: product-detail text was absent from the retrieved pages, so nothing could be evidence-quoted
flags.detail: On 2026-10-22 (session S-75094819) two Catbird engagement product pages were fetched in full (Night at the Ballet Diamond Ring, Emerald Cut — 'from $5,300.00' visible; Odile the Swan Black Diamond Ring — 'from $1,600.00' visible). In both cases the retrieved text contained the product name and starting price but NOT the materials/details block, so karat, solid-gold wording, width and weight could not be backed by verbatim quotes and no rows were added. Search snippets for these pages show material details, but snippets are rejected sources in this project (F-004/F-005/F-006). Catbird is a promising candidate for a future pass with a fetcher that can read the details tab.
flags.recommended_action: Re-attempt Catbird capture with a browser that renders the product-details section; only add rows once karat and any 'solid gold' wording can be quoted verbatim from the page itself.
